item.title: Bulletin updated at 04:50 HKT 15/Feb/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
An easterly airstream will affect the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. It will be windy with some rain over the region in the middle and latter parts of this week. A cold front is expected to reach southern China over the weekend. The weather will become cold over the region. Under the influence of an upper-air disturbance and the replenishment of the monsoon, it will remain cold with some rain over southern China early next week.
